instructions.description: 破坏position={x, y, z}的方块。
instructions.description_en: Break the block at position={x, y, z}.

instructions.description: 破坏从from={x, y, z}到to={x, y, z}的方块。
instructions.description_en: Break blocks from from={x, y, z} to to={x, y, z}.

instructions.description: 查看position={x, y, z}的方块。
instructions.description_en: Inspect the block at position={x, y, z}.

instructions.description: 查看从from={x, y, z}到to={x, y, z}的方块。
instructions.description_en: Inspect blocks from from={x, y, z} to to={x, y, z}.

instructions.description: 挖掘position={x, y, z} 处及附近相邻的相同方块。
instructions.description_en: Mine the block at position={x, y, z} and adjacent identical blocks.

instructions.description: 将item放在position={x, y, z}处。
instructions.description_en: Place item at position={x, y, z}.

instructions.description: 使用item填充从from={x, y, z}到to={x, y, z}。
instructions.description_en: Fill from from={x, y, z} to to={x, y, z} with item.

instructions.description: 通信发送message。
instructions.description_en: Send message to communicate.

instructions.description: 向username发送message。
instructions.description_en: Send message to username.

instructions.description: 攻击target。
instructions.description_en: Attack target.

instructions.description: 安全靠近target至进入攻击范围，并攻击 target（target 可写 <种类>_<id>，如 zombie_73；武器可选，缺省使用当前手持或空手；战斗任务中 weapon 可使用装备标识，如 diamond_sword_1，与当前所持武器不同时自动切换。”）。
instructions.description_en: Move close to target until within attack range, then attack target (target may be <kind>_<id> like zombie_73; weapon optional, defaults to held item or empty hand; combat tasks also accept an equipment registry identifier such as diamond_sword_1).

instructions.description: 装备远程武器weapon攻击target；战斗任务中weapon可使用装备注册标识。
instructions.description_en: Equip a ranged weapon or its combat-task registry identifier and attack target.

instructions.description: 装备近战武器weapon攻击target；战斗任务中weapon可使用装备注册标识。
instructions.description_en: Equip a melee weapon or its combat-task registry identifier and attack target.

instructions.description: 感知范围内的敌对实体与附近箱子。
instructions.description_en: Hostile entities and nearby chests within perception range.

instructions.description: 观察周围，寻找是否存在敌对实体与掉落物。
instructions.description_en: Observe the surroundings for hostile entities and dropped items.

instructions.description: 远离target。
instructions.description_en: Move away from target.

instructions.description: 使用背包内的食物或药水。
instructions.description_en: Use food or a potion.

instructions.description: 查看position={x, y, z}箱子的内容。
instructions.description_en: Inspect the contents of the chest at position={x, y, z}.

instructions.description: 列出所有已注册箱子。
instructions.description_en: List all registered chests.

instructions.description: 从position={x, y, z}/chest/chest_id箱子取出num_X个item_X。
instructions.description_en: Take num_X of item_X from the chest at position={x, y, z}/chest/chest_id.

instructions.description: 放入num_X个item_X到position={x, y, z}/chest/chest_id箱子。
instructions.description_en: Put num_X of item_X into the chest at position={x, y, z}/chest/chest_id.

instructions.description: 查询item的合成配方。
instructions.description_en: Query the crafting recipe for item.

instructions.description: 按recipe_index合成num个item。
instructions.description_en: Craft num of item using recipe_index.

instructions.description: 合成num个item。
instructions.description_en: Craft num of item.

instructions.description: 装备item。
instructions.description_en: Equip item.

instructions.description: 卸下装备（支持单个或列表）。
instructions.description_en: Unequip equipment (single or list).

instructions.description: 自动装备当前最佳战斗装备。
instructions.description_en: Automatically equip the best combat gear.

instructions.description: 收割num个crop。
instructions.description_en: Harvest num of crop.

instructions.description: 寻找附近可用的熔炉。
instructions.description_en: Find a nearby usable furnace.

instructions.description: 打开position={x, y, z}的熔炉。
instructions.description_en: Open the furnace at position={x, y, z}.

instructions.description: 向position={x, y, z}熔炉放入num个燃料item。
instructions.description_en: Put num of fuel item into the furnace at position={x, y, z}.

instructions.description: 向position={x, y, z}熔炉放入num个原料item。
instructions.description_en: Put num of input item into the furnace at position={x, y, z}.

instructions.description: 取出position={x, y, z}熔炉燃料槽中的全部燃料。
instructions.description_en: Take all fuel from the fuel slot of the furnace at position={x, y, z}.

instructions.description: 取出position={x, y, z}熔炉原料槽中的全部原料。
instructions.description_en: Take all input from the input slot of the furnace at position={x, y, z}.

instructions.description: 从position={x, y, z}熔炉取出产物。
instructions.description_en: Take the output from the furnace at position={x, y, z}.

instructions.description: 使用position={x, y, z}的熔炉，放入num_item个原料item与num_fuel个fuel
instructions.description_en: Use the furnace at position={x, y, z} to put in num_item of input item and num_fuel of fuel.

instructions.description: 关闭当前熔炉界面。
instructions.description_en: Close the current furnace interface.

instructions.description: 列出背包中的全部物品。
instructions.description_en: List all items in the inventory.

instructions.description: 查看背包详细内容与物品统计。
instructions.description_en: Inspect inventory details and item statistics.

instructions.description: 统计指定物品的持有数量。
instructions.description_en: Count how many of the specified item are held.

instructions.description: 判断背包中是否持有指定物品。
instructions.description_en: Check whether the inventory holds the specified item.

instructions.description: 从背包中按名称、装备注册标识或slot槽位编号装备物品；同名物品无标识时优先有附魔且按slot靠前。
instructions.description_en: Equip an inventory item by name, combat-task registry identifier, or slot; without an identifier, enchanted matches and lower slots have priority.

instructions.description: 按指定位置拾取掉落物。
instructions.description_en: Pick up dropped items at the given positions.

instructions.description: 丢弃items中的物品到当前位置地面。
instructions.description_en: Drop the items onto the ground at the current position.

instructions.description: 靠近target并把items中的物品丢给对方拾取。
instructions.description_en: Move near target and drop the items for them to pick up.

instructions.description: 移动到position附近并挖取该位置的钻石矿。
instructions.description_en: Move near position and mine the diamond ore at that position.

instructions.description: 移动到position附近并挖取该位置的绿宝石矿。
instructions.description_en: Move near position and mine the emerald ore at that position.

instructions.description: 移动到position附近并挖取该位置的金矿。
instructions.description_en: Move near position and mine the gold ore at that position.

instructions.description: 移动到position附近并挖取该位置的铁矿。
instructions.description_en: Move near position and mine the iron ore at that position.

instructions.description: 移动到position附近并挖取该位置的青金石矿。
instructions.description_en: Move near position and mine the lapis lazuli ore at that position.

instructions.description: 移动到position附近并挖取该位置的下界合金矿。
instructions.description_en: Move near position and mine the netherite ore at that position.

instructions.description: 移动到坐标 position={x,y,z}。
instructions.description_en: Move to coordinates position={x,y,z}.

instructions.description: 前往最近的方块block_name。
instructions.description_en: Go to the nearest block block_name.

instructions.description: 持续跟随目标坐标position={x,y,z}。
instructions.description_en: Continuously follow target coordinates position={x,y,z}.

instructions.description: 持续跟随实体entity_name。
instructions.description_en: Continuously follow entity entity_name.

instructions.description: 定向探索并寻找目标（direction 可选）。
instructions.description_en: Explore directionally to find the target (direction is optional).

instructions.description: 使用食物或药水。
instructions.description_en: Use food or a potion.

instructions.description: 查看自己的箱子与商店状态。
instructions.description_en: Inspect your own chests and shop status.

instructions.description: 查看shop_name的库存与售价。
instructions.description_en: Inspect the inventory and prices of shop_name.

instructions.description: 在container中进行拿取/存放num_X个item_X。
instructions.description_en: Take/store num_X of item_X in container.

instructions.description: 从shop_name购买count个item。
instructions.description_en: Buy count of item from shop_name.

instructions.description: 合成count个item。
instructions.description_en: Craft count of item.

instructions.description: 从container中拿取num_X个item_X。
instructions.description_en: Take num_X of item_X from container.

instructions.description: 将num_X个item_X存入container。
instructions.description_en: Store num_X of item_X into container.

instructions.description: 等待秒数seconds。
instructions.description_en: Wait for seconds.
